listing.name: Super Mario Maker 2 (smm2recomp)
listing.summary: Experimental AArch64 to C ahead of time; native Horizon/NVN runtime Metal/Vulkan. Upstream maturity: Early. Mac course play reference; Windows tester reports; Deck slow, Linux ARM title in VM; Android emulator only. Online Nextendo untested on hardware. Acquisition: Packages are launcher/recompiler plus compiler; first setup validates and builds owned game locally. Platforms: Actual Windows x64(x86-64-v2), Linux x64(v2)/aarch64, Apple Silicon macOS15+ packages. Intel Mac15+ AVX2 source-only; Android/iOS source-only. Original data: Own SMM2 base plus3.0.3 update, NSP/XCI or extracted ExeFS/RomFS; prod.keys and firmware system NCAs for fonts/Mii. Optional100MarioChallenge needs separate owned WiiU SMM1 dump. Portcove setup/gameplay untested; no operational integration offered.
